source_context_translations.translation: Now only because it does not dwell, it therefore does not depart.

Not valuing the worthy will keep the people from contending; not esteeming hard-to-get goods will keep the people from theft; not displaying what can be desired will keep the people's hearts and minds from disorder.
Thus even the wise would not dare to act.

The Way is empty, yet when used it is never exhausted; deep and still, it seems to be the ancestor of the myriad things. It blunts its sharpness, unties its knots, softens its brightness, and merges with its dust; deep and still, it seems somehow to exist.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): An adult male person; by extension, one’s husband.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): The ordinary nominal sense, not the sentence particle.
Sentence Translations (English): He is the eldest among men.
This old man does not know.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A discourse particle used to open or frame a statement, often with a mildly emphatic or introductory force.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Adds a discursive, sentence-opening emphasis rather than naming a person or thing.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese, received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To perceive with the eyes or become aware of something visually.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): The ordinary perceptual sense, distinct from causative ‘show’.
Sentence Translations (English): By climbing high, one sees far.
At nightfall, one cannot see anyone.
Only now do I see it.
When the traveler came from afar, I had already seen him.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To come into view or be manifested so that others can perceive it.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Intransitive or passive-like use, distinct from causative ‘show’.
Sentence Translations (English): When the sun rises, light appears.
When the clouds part, the mountains appear.
When virtue is abundant, reputation shows itself.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): To make something visible or present it openly to others.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Causative or transitive use, not the intransitive sense of ‘to see’.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese, received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): The inner feelings, thoughts, and mental state of the people as a collective.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Refers collectively to public inward disposition, not individual ‘mind’ in isolation.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese, received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): People who are regarded as wise, intelligent, or resourceful.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): A class of persons characterized by wisdom or cleverness, not the abstract quality alone.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese, received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To move forward quickly and forcefully, or to surge toward something.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): An action of forceful movement, not the condition of emptiness.
Sentence Translations (English): The horse galloped and charged the formation.
The soldiers charged straight at the gate.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): Not filled up; lacking solid content so that there is room within or through it.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Here it describes functional emptiness: capacity through lack of fullness.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese, received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
